entities.name: Leptines of Syracuse
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leptines was a military leader from Syracuse, Sicily, Magna Graecia, active during his brother, Dionysius the Elder's wars. He showed bravery in the fights against Carthage and mercy with the Thurians.
